necessary: Mistaken death declaration caused by a hospital clerical/record mix-up with a deceased patient; Jane was alive.
7.partial: Explicit premature/mistaken death declaration without the administrative mechanism can earn 1; a deliberate prank, staged death or surprise party cannot.
7.incidental: Names, date, funeral arrangements and exactly when staff corrected the mistake are optional.

necessary: A specialized fire-resistant protective suit allowed survival in the blaze.
29.partial: Explicitly protective fireproof clothing without specifying a suit can earn 1. A safe room or compartment is an incompatible mechanism.
29.incidental: Military/experimental provenance, radio malfunction, names and memorial are optional.

necessary: Emily was mistakenly declared dead and escaped premature burial using a prepared coffin escape mechanism.
The fictitious return address was a prearranged code signalling to her family that she was safe while concealing her actual location.
40.partial: One correct core component, or explicit mistaken burial plus escape without its prepared mechanism, earns 1. Generic secrecy alone is not the coded signal. Deliberately faking death is not mistaken burial. A trusted intermediary alone is not either mechanism.
40.incidental: Criminal threats, identity of helpers and travel details are optional.

necessary: Umbrellas shield residents from falling volcanic ash despite no rain.
58.partial: Explicit protection of people from airborne environmental ash/debris without its volcanic origin earns 1. Protecting possessions, fashion, UV, or generic unspecified environmental factors does not identify the core mechanism.
58.incidental: Wind strength and exact volcano distance are optional.

necessary: The room is a virtual reality simulation; pausing or exiting it allows Sarah to get physical coffee and return.
70.partial: Explicit recognition of a VR/simulated room without explaining pause/exit earns 1. Physical hidden passages, openings or coffee compartments are incompatible.
70.incidental: Names, device brand and exact coffee location are optional.
